units: <cite ref="Eruvin 55b">Erub. 55ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Eiruvin 6:4">Tosef. ib. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Eiruvin 5:4">V</cite>), 4 <he>הקבר והג׳ וכ׳</he> graves and bridges (in the outskirts of towns) which have a place of shelter.—

Gen. R. s. 76, end עשה עצמו כג׳ וכ׳ Jacob constituted himself a ferry, taking persons from one shore and setting them down on the other (Mat. K. כגַשָּׁר like a ferry-man).—Pl. גְּשָׁרִים, גְּשָׁרִין.
<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 9:4">Ib. IX, 4</cite> <he>ג׳ המפולשים</he> bridges under which there is an open passage.
